programmes.title: OneDay@BCG Virtual Experience
programmes.eligibility: For anyone exploring consulting or a career at BCG. The page states no other eligibility limits.
programmes.review_notes: BCG's page calls the job simulations free and virtual. Modules are enrolled through Forage.

programmes.title: Bain Breaks it Down (webinar series)
programmes.eligibility: Some sessions are open to all candidates; others are labelled MBA 1st year or undergraduate. Register for each session separately.
programmes.duration: Live virtual sessions of 45-60 minutes; listed sessions run 15 Oct to 10 Nov 2026 (US Eastern time)
programmes.review_notes: Session list read from Bain's page on 12 Oct 2026. Cost is not stated on the page. Sessions include case examples, AI in practice and case interview demonstrations.

programmes.title: ExperienceBain (pre-MBA programme)
programmes.eligibility: Admitted incoming first-year MBA students at about 60 listed schools (North America, Europe, Middle East, Asia-Pacific). No Indian business school appears on the list.
programmes.duration: June to early August; about 1-2 one-hour sessions a week, flexible. Select invite-only in-person meetings may be offered.
programmes.expected_window: Spring 2027 (Bain's page says to check back then)
programmes.review_notes: Bain's page says 2026 registration is closed and to check back in Spring 2027 for the next cohort. The 2026 programme ran June to early August.

programmes.title: McKinsey Early Access (pre-MBA programme, 2026 edition)
programmes.eligibility: Admitted to a full-time MBA programme in the US or Canada, graduating in 2028. Dual-degree students welcome. Not open to Indian MBA programmes.
programmes.duration: Virtual sessions May to July, plus some in-person events at select offices and campuses
programmes.review_notes: Deadline was 11 May 2026, extended to 15 May (as stated on McKinsey's page). Next edition dates are not announced.

programmes.title: BCG Unlock (pre-MBA programme, 2026 edition)
programmes.eligibility: Mainly first-year students of two-year MBA programmes starting Fall 2026. All pre-MBA students may register, but the page highlights about 40 listed schools; the only Asian school named is HKUST (none in India).
programmes.duration: Optional virtual sessions from June to early August; 45-60 minutes each, mostly at North American times
programmes.review_notes: Register-by date was 18 May 2026; BCG's page says later registrations were considered on a rolling basis. Registration needs a resume. Next edition dates are not announced.

programmes.review_notes: Forage page shows a free simulation on insurance, actuarial and asset management consulting work. Forage's note says completing it is not work experience.

programmes.title: McKinsey Forward (free learning programme)
programmes.eligibility: Career starters and job changers in eligible countries. Whether India is eligible is not stated on McKinsey's page.
programmes.duration: 10 weeks, about 2 hours a week, then an ongoing alumni network
programmes.review_notes: HIDDEN until checked. McKinsey's page lists regions, not countries, and does not name India. It says to register interest to be told when applications reopen in your country. A third-party site mentions a 5 Oct 2026 deadline, which McKinsey's page does not confirm. Please check the FAQ at mckinsey.org/our-programs/forward/faq for India.
